name: Students for Environmental Action at Weston High School
description: Student club at Weston High School that runs recycling and composting, removes invasive plants, grows lettuce in the school greenhouse and lobbies state legislators on climate bills.

name: Youth Climate Action Now
description: Youth-led group under Climate Action Now that holds monthly workshops, webinars, creative events and advocacy training to get young people involved in climate action.

name: Youth Action Collaborative Alumni Node at  Clean Water Action
description: Clean Water Action program that trains high school students from environmental justice communities as advocates on climate justice, PFAS, lead and zero waste; started with a Malden High School cohort, with an alumni chapter planned.

name: HealthLink
description: Grassroots environmental group based in Swampscott focused on reducing pollution and toxins, especially power plant and air pollution, and promoting renewable energy.

name: Climate Action Now Western Massachusetts
description: Grassroots volunteer group in Western Massachusetts focused on climate justice organizing and public education; its youth wing is Youth Climate Action Now.

description: Resident-led group that organizes Boston neighborhoods and works with social justice allies to push the city and state for climate justice, on issues like green buildings, community choice electricity, gas leaks and school sustainability.

name: Community Labor United
description: Boston coalition-building organization that brings community groups and labor unions together on campaigns for working families, including green energy through the Green Justice Coalition, childcare, transit and construction worker protections.

description: Cambridge-based consumer nonprofit that educates and organizes households to switch to clean energy through programs for green power, electric vehicles, solar, heat pumps and efficiency, and advocates for climate policy.

description: Statewide group of progressive citizens that works on elections, training and coalition work for social justice and reform, and takes part in the Mass Power Forward clean energy coalition.

name: Sustainable Sharon Coalition
description: Sharon community group, active since 2013, that educates and organizes residents on sustainability, including land and water conservation, energy and home energy assessments.

name: League of Women Voters of Massachusetts
description: State League of Women Voters that has a steering committee on environmental action and advocates for climate, energy and water legislation and runs a Climate and Energy Solutions series.

name: Chinese Progressive Association
description: Boston community organizing group, founded in 1977, that organizes Chinese-American residents; its Green Justice program covers weatherization jobs, transit justice, air quality and community microgrids through the Green Justice Coalition.

actions: Volunteer or Become a Member of CPA

name: Green Weymouth
description: Weymouth community coalition that educates and advocates for conservation, sustainable policies, clean energy and green growth in town.

name: Sustainable Business Network of Massachusetts
description: Cambridge nonprofit business association, founded in 1988, that builds networks of independent, socially and environmentally minded businesses and runs programs such as the Boston Local Food Network.

projects: Sustainable Business of the Year Awards

name: Vermont Interfaith Power & Light
description: Faith-based climate group that partners with 75+ faith communities and gives Climate Action Grants for building energy upgrades.

projects: Climate Action Grants for faith communities

name: Lake Champlain Committee
description: Burlington-based advocacy group working since 1963 for a healthy, accessible Lake Champlain; a partner on the Environmental Common Agenda.

name: CarShare Vermont
description: Car-sharing service in the Burlington area; a member of Transportation for Vermonters, Energy Action Network and Vermont Clean Communities.

name: Vermont Council on Rural Development
description: Montpelier nonprofit supporting community development; one of the five supporting organizations of VECAN and an Energy Action Network member.

name: AARP Vermont
description: Vermont state office of AARP; a member of Transportation for Vermonters.

name: Charlotte Energy & Climate Action Committee
description: Town committee working on energy since 2010; championed the 2025-26 Town Energy Modernization Project (rooftop solar and heat pumps for town buildings).

name: Cornerstone Housing Partners
description: Rutland-based housing nonprofit that offers homebuyer assistance, home repair grants and loans, and the Heat Squad energy audits and energy loans for efficient home upgrades.

name: The Nature Conservancy in Vermont
description: Vermont chapter of The Nature Conservancy, which has protected over 300,000 acres, stewards dozens of natural areas and runs a conservation grant program.

name: Vermont Sustainable Jobs Fund
description: Montpelier nonprofit that supports Vermont's sustainable economy through business accelerators in clean energy and forestry, business coaching for energy contractors and the Farm to Plate network.

events.name: 16th Annual Farm to Plate Network Gathering

name: Greensboro Energy & Climate Action Committee
description: Town committee working for an equitable transition to a sustainable energy future through home energy efficiency, clean energy projects, education and community action.

name: Shelburne Climate & Energy Committee
description: Town committee that works on the Shelburne long-term energy future per the Town Plan, with projects on renewable-energy requirements for new construction, low-income weatherization and rooftop solar on town buildings.

name: Families Rise Up
description: Group of central Vermont families organizing together toward a just transition, listed as a 350Vermont node.
